steps.code:
# Parse all notes to extract date and habit values
import re

rows = []
for note in all_notes:
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for 2023-05-17"
    match = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', note['title'])
    if not match:
        continue
    date = match.group(1)
    
    # Parse content lines
    content_lines = note['content'].split('\n')
    habit_values = {}
    for line in content_lines[1:]:  # skip header
        if ':' in line:
            habit, value = line.split(':', 1)
            habit = habit.strip()
            value = value.strip().lower()
            if value in ('yes', 'no'):
                habit_values[habit] = value
    
    rows.append((date, habit_values))

# Sort by date ascending
rows.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])

print("First few rows:")
for date, hv in rows[:3]:
    print(date, hv)
print("Total rows:", len(rows))
